corrections.defect: Cost multiplier changes execution cost only, not entry eligibility
corrections.fix: Add entry filter: |expected_move_H_bps| > cost_multiple * (spread_bps + 0.40). Direction = sign(expected_move_H). expected_move_H = slope * H_bars converted to bps.

corrections.defect: GMM cond_means uses contemporaneous return (train_data[:,0]) instead of future-H return
corrections.fix: For each horizon H in [6,12,24,48] (5-min bars), construct causal label: (mid[t+H]-mid[t])/mid[t]*1e4. Fit GMM on features from past only. Estimate E[future_ret_H | regime=k] from training. Prediction = sum_k P(k|x_t) * E[ret_H|k].

corrections.defect: Ranks only 6-bar momentum. Protocol requires 3 features: recent return, residual return, trend persistence
corrections.fix: At each anchor: (1) recent_return = sum(ret[i-6:i]), (2) residual_return = recent_return - cross_sectional_mean(recent_return), (3) trend_persistence = sign consistency of ret[i-6:i] (fraction of same-sign bars). Standardize each cross-sectionally (z-score), combine with equal weight (1/3 each), rank all 13 pairs.

corrections.defect: cid uses dyn[:4] causing 'residual_momentum' and 'residual_drift' to both become 'resi'. Only 8 unique IDs instead of 16.
corrections.fix: Use full dynamic name: R4_usd_momentum_h30, R4_usd_drift_h30, R4_pca_momentum_h30, R4_pca_drift_h30, etc. Assert 16 unique IDs before P&L.

corrections.defect: mid, bo, ao = a['mid'], a['ao'], a['bo'] - BID and ASK are SWAPPED
corrections.fix: Correct to: mid=a['mid'], bo=a['bo'], ao=a['ao']. Add hard test proving long entry=ASK, exit=BID.

corrections.defect: Training always uses ret[i+6] target, same model reused for all horizons
corrections.fix: For each (arch, ctx, horizon), train distinct model on t->t+H target. H in [6,12,24,48] 5-min bars. Still 2 arch x 2 ctx x 4 horizons = 16.

corrections.defect: Return-like expected_move compared directly against spread_bps. Dimensional mismatch causes zero trades.
corrections.fix: Convert all to BPS. R1: expected_move_H_bps = slope * H_bars * 1e4 (log return to bps). R2: regime-weighted E[ret_H] already in bps. Compare |exp_move_bps| > spread_bps + 0.40 * cost_mult. Horizon-specific for both sources.

corrections.defect: Panel P&L returns bid/ask gross without explicit transaction cost
corrections.fix: Apply 0.40 bps round-trip per completed position (2 legs for long-short pair = 0.80 bps total). Report gross, explicit_cost, net separately.
